sloka: ततः त्वाम् शरणार्थम् च शरण्यम् समुपस्थिताः ।परिपालय नः राम वध्यमानान् निशाचरैः ॥३-६-१९॥
transliteration: tataḥ tvām śaraṇārtham ca śaraṇyam samupasthitāḥ ।paripālaya naḥ rāma vadhyamānān niśācaraiḥ ॥3-6-19॥

translations.english: O Rama, you are worthy of refuge. Hence we have come to you seeking your protection. We are being killed by the nightstalkers. Save us.
